name: guard
shortdesc: Resource agent that masks a chain of resources.
longdesc:
This is a resource agent that allows masking of
other resources. It checks some condition and returns
an error code on start / promote and monitor if the
condition is set. The condition can be set and reset with
the (non-OCF-conformant) mask / unmask actions.

parameters.name: token
parameters.longdesc:
A name that identifies the mask, so we can have
multiple chains with different mask values.
